mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes ivabradine, leading to increased ivabradine plasma concentrations and enhanced bradycardic and hypotensive effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or reduce ivabradine dose by 50% if clarithromycin is necessary; consider alternative antibiotics with less CYP3A4 inhibition; monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely.
